text:
nina: kicking off canary rollout v2026.3.1 -> eu1 at 3%. prefill=false for this run, will watch for 15m
deploybot: canary started: id=canary-2026-03-22-03 image=redwood/inference:v2026.3.1 routes=[/generate,/embed] synth=smoke-latency-3m
lucas: seeing a burst of 429s on /generate from the canary: p95 spiking and 429s are ~2% of samples
sre-oncall: paste metrics? is it retry storm or rate limiter?
lucas: quick sample:
```
/metrics?window=60s -> generate_429=78, generate_p95=1.6s, generate_5xx=2
proxy-log: upstream rate-limiter rejected token bucket: available=0 requested=5
```
anya: looks like token-bucket exhaustion on the proxy side when concurrent prefills were off. maybe the refill-rate for the canary pool is too low
nina: can we temporarily relax proxy rate limit for canary? prefer not to rollback if it's config tweak
sre-oncall: +1 to try config bump. @deploybot can you patch canary proxy rl to bucket=2000/refill=200/s for this window? revert after 20m
deploybot: patch executed on canary nodes: proxy_rl(bucket=2000, refill=200/s). monitoring...
lucas: running a focused synthetic against generate: `for i in {1..40}; do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}\n" -H \"Authorization: Bearer $T\" -d '{\"input\":\"test\"}' https://eu1.api.redwood.inference/v1/generate; done`

lucas: post-patch sample -> 200 x 38, 429 x 2 but p95 down to 420ms
sre-oncall: improvement. drop in p95 and 429 rate way down. keep at 3% and observe 20m
anya: opening a release note: observed proxy token-bucket exhaustion on canary without prefill; mitigation was to temporarily increase refill rate. follow-up: evaluate default refill for low-volume canaries
nina: agree. no rollback. schedule autoscaler/proxy config follow-up in the sprint. if 5xx or 429s climb back, we rollback to v2026.3.0
deploybot: smoke snapshot (5m): generate_p95=0.42s, generate_429=0.3%, embed_p95=0.21s, embed_5xx=0
lucas: leaving debug logging on proxy for canary for 10m
sre-oncall: noted. thanks all. will close the thread after hold window. :thumbsup:
